title: Pope Leo XIV Visits Lourdes, Denounces Sexual Violence in Catholic Church
detail: Pope Leo XIV visited the Marian shrine at Lourdes and reaffirmed his opposition to assisted dying legislation while denouncing sexual violence within the Catholic Church as a 'scourge'. The papal visit underscores France's ongoing debate over end-of-life law reform and the Church's efforts to address internal abuse scandals.

title: French Senate Elections 2026: Live Results Underway
detail: The 2026 Sénatoriales (French Senate elections) are underway with live results coverage, marking a significant domestic political event. Senate seats are contested across multiple departments with results being tallied in real time.
